# Fanfarr v0.5.33

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Director, now a column too

The director filter grows up: an opt-in library column, off by default and
switchable in the Columns modal. Sortable, with multiple names joined by
commas -- and every name in the table is a filter link, the same
dotted-underline treatment as the item page. Clicking one narrows the table
in place while keeping the sort and the rest of the filters.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
